stem: Justin wants to improve his introduction. How can he rewrite sentence 6 to provide more detail and imagery?

options.label: F
options.text: I told my parents in every way I could think of that the city simply wasn’t the place for me.

options.label: G
options.text: The traffic, the busyness, and the noises of the city would be nothing compared with the beautiful, amazing, lovely countryside.

options.label: H
options.text: Without fields to roam, horses to ride, and streams to fish, what could the city possibly have to offer?

options.label: J
options.text: The city wasn’t going to be the great place to live that the country had always been.
